_note: CMP-02 Inputs & form controls — page '02 — Components', section 'CMP-02 Inputs & form controls' (id 13:569, x 8000, y 0). Use I(id, {variant}, {props}) from helpers.js. Value/placeholder text is per-variant (not a TEXT prop): override the 'Value text' layer on the instance when needed. Instance-swap icon props take ICONS[...] ids.

Input/Text.note: M = 40 px, L = 48 px (use L on mobile). Default leading icon = mail (email example). Override 'Value text' / 'Helper text' layers per use.

Input/Password.note: Login: Show strength=false, Show requirements=false. Eye toggle is a nested Button/Icon (Ghost S).

Input/Amount.note: Header 'Available 9,215.30 USDT' + DEMO XS, Number/M value, Token/USDT suffix, MAX chip, fiat hint, limits 'Min 20.00 · Max 25,000.00 per day'. Error = 'Exceeds your available balance (9,215.30 USDT)'.

Input/Address.note: Arbitrum example; header holds a Wallet/Network Pill instance; Paste + Scan QR are Button/Icon Ghost S; New address shows the 24 h cooldown callout.

Input/OTP.note: 6 boxes 48x56, Geist Mono digits bound to font/family/mono + font/size/number-m. Motion note frame 'Note — OTP error shake' = 16:3763.

Input/Search.note: S 32 px x 280, M 40 px x 400. Shortcut chip shows ⌘K (Default) / Esc (Focus); Filled shows Clear button.

Input/Textarea.note: Counter 'n / 500'; Error shows 512 / 500 with scroll indicator.

Control/Checkbox.note: Default variant = Unchecked (never pre-check consent). Default label: 'I confirm I am 18+ and located in a permitted jurisdiction'.

Control/Toggle.note: Default On=No. Never default ON for spend/risk-increasing settings.

Control/Slider.note: Single = daily loss limit 0–1,000 USDT at 200; Range = amount filter 500–2,500 of 0–5,000. Track area is a fixed 360 px frame (absolute thumbs/tooltips).

Input/Date Range.note: Open = calendar popover, Nov 2026, range 20–27 (Custom preset), presets Today / 7 days / 30 days / Custom, Clear + Apply.

Input/File Upload.note: KYC dropzone; Uploading at 63%; Error 'File is blurry — retake in good light'.

Form/Field Group — Login example.note: Composed login card 20:9457 built from Input/Text (Filled, L), Input/Password (Focus, Fair, strength+requirements hidden), Control/Checkbox (Unchecked), Button/Primary L, Button/Secondary L, Badge/18+; plus 8 field-group rules.
